messages:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High error rate detected for route /v1/embeddings (eu-west-1). 5xxs spiking from 2025-09-12T09:24Z. Possible routing/fallback issue. paging oncall_priya

oncall_priya: Got the page, looking now. Can folks post any recent deploys or routing config changes?

sre_alex: Not seeing infra deploys in last hour. Alert shows a lot of responses routed to model 'redwood-model-v2-instruct' with embed requests -> incompatible runtime errors. Suspect pinned alias drift.

eng_leah: Confirmed: alias "embed-prod" is pinned to version "v2-instruct" in the control plane. That variant is chat/instruct optimized, not embed. Looks like a release automation job accidentally pinned the alias during a rollout.

ops_jordan: :face_with_raised_eyebrow: Who ran the pin job? Any audit log?

eng_leah: Audit snippet: ```
# control plane audit
user: deploy-bot
action: pin_alias
alias: embed-prod
from: v1-embed
to: v2-instruct
ts: 2025-09-12T09:18:07Z
```

prod_maya: Customer-impact: we have 2 enterprise customers reporting degraded embed ingestion and elevated latencies. Support ticket count rising. Need ETA for mitigation.

oncall_priya: Triage plan: 1) Roll back alias to v1-embed (hot path). 2) Add temporary policy to block instruct variants for embedding routes. 3) Notify customers. Who can run rollback now?

eng_leah: I can run the rollback. Proposed command: ```
/redwood alias set embed-prod --version v1-embed --force --reason "rollback: mis-pinned v2-instruct"
```

sre_alex: Before you run, double-check that v1-embed is healthy in eu-west-1. Doing quick health check...```logs
healthcheck v1-embed eu-west-1 -> ok, 99.9% ready
connectivity -> ok
```

eng_leah: Running rollback now. `/redwood alias set embed-prod --version v1-embed --force`

incident_bot: ACTION: alias embed-prod rolled back to v1-embed by eng_leah @ 2025-09-12T09:30:12Z

ops_jordan: Observability: 5xxs for /v1/embeddings dropping. Latency back to baseline in ~1m. Still seeing some caches with prior responses.

customer_alert_bot: Customer notifications queued for affected orgs. Template: "We're investigating an embedding ingestion regression; a rollback was performed. We'll follow up with root cause."

prod_maya: Please capture impact numbers: approximate requests affected and duration for the postmortem. Support, can you gather ticket IDs?

oncall_priya: Support team provided quick counts: ~1.2k failed embedding requests across two customers between 09:18 and 09:30 UTC. I'll add to incident timeline.

eng_leah: Root cause initial: deployment automation (deploy-bot) ran an alias sync job that applied a batch pin mapping. The job lacks a guard to verify variant compatibility for route type. The YAML that drove it:```yaml
mappings:
  - alias: embed-prod
    version: v2-instruct
    force: true
```

sre_alex: Mitigation done. Next steps: 1) add invariant check in alias sync to validate variant compatibility (embed vs gen vs chat) 2) add a temporary kill-switch preventing instruct variants being mapped to embed routes 3) update rollout runbook to confirm checks.

eng_leah: I'll open PR for alias sync validation and a migration to mark allowed interfaces per model variant. Drafting fix now.

ops_jordan: Also recommend we make fallback policy opt-in for mixed-interface routes. Current default allowed fallback to any compatible variant, which is risky. Add policy flag `fallback_to_compatible_only: true` for embed routes.

prod_maya: From comms POV, we'll send a follow-up with timeline + actions. No SLA breach yet but customers impacted; classify as SEV-2.

oncall_priya: Any risk of repeat while PR lands? Could the sync job re-run?

eng_leah: The sync job runs every 5m. I've disabled the deploy-bot job temporarily and locked alias edits for embed-prod until patch lands. Command run: `/redwood jobs pause deploy-bot-sync` -> success.

incident_bot: NOTE: job deploy-bot-sync paused by eng_leah @ 2025-09-12T09:38:04Z

customer_alert_bot: Notifying affected customers: messages sent. Support is on standby.

sre_alex: Post-mortem items assigned: ENG-342 (alias validation), INFRA-129 (hard lock for embed alias edits), DOCS-77 (runbook update), COMMS-21 (customer follow-up).

prod_maya: Good. Please keep timeline and logs attached. We'll schedule postmortem for tomorrow.

oncall_priya: Closing the active page. Marking incident as mitigated. If anyone sees any residual errors, ping this thread. :white_check_mark:

eng_leah: Leaving notes in incident tracker and creating the PR now.```

sre_alex: Quick snippet of the problematic trace for the postmortem: ```
ERROR route=/v1/embeddings request_id=abc123 model_variant=v2-instruct runtime_error="incompatible_interface: requested embeddings but model exposes text_gen"
stack: runtime/routing/fallback.go:412
```

oncall_priya: Thanks all. Logging out of rotation for a bit.

eng_leah: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/alias-sync/pull/456 (adds compatibility checks).

prod_maya: I'll draft the customer post-incident note and share here for review.

incident_bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: embed route errors reduced to baseline. Incident severity SEV-2. Timeline and tasks recorded.

oncall_priya: Closing thread.
